acceptance_criteria: The layers mode prints each edge classified as foundation, domain or integrator and flags lateral domain edges
The check mode exits non-zero for a new lateral edge and zero when the only violations are allowlisted
The six seeded allowlist entries each reference a ticket so removal is tracked
The allowlist is a tracked file, not constants in code
task.description: Phase 1b of GB-200. The six domain-to-domain edges are invisible to any gate today, so the mesh can grow while the foundation crates are built. Add a layers mode with a declared layer map (foundation: gaugeblock-contracts, miter-ast, miter-storage, miter-harness; domain: miter-engine, storypole-core, sawhorse-core, dado-core, batten-core, chalkline-core; integrator: joiner-core, benchwork-core, outfeed-core, rabbet-core plus the per-repo cli, mcp and facade crates) and a check mode that exits non-zero on a lateral domain edge or on any edge absent from a tracked allowlist file. Seed the allowlist with the six existing edges, each carrying its own ticket reference, so the suite stays green on day one and every entry is tracked debt for B2.
task.title: Teach miter deps layers and gate new lateral edges behind an allowlist

receipt.summary: miter deps now classifies every crate edge into foundation / domain / integrator and gates the lateral ones. Layers derive from package names (gaugeblock-* foundation, bare name facade/integrator, -cli/-mcp integrator, else domain), so no per-repo config exists to drift. --check exits 0 on a clean graph and 1 naming the offending edge; proven by removing one allowlist entry. Same-layer edges get a family dimension so a product own internals (miter-engine -> miter-ast, 71 sites) and facade -> own -mcp are exempt rather than debt; upward edges are never excusable. Measured 2026-10-30: 42 crates, 107 edges, 84 downward, 23 lateral all seeded into .gaugeblock/miter/layers-allowlist.toml with GB-204, 0 upward. The audit prior figure of 6 lateral edges was a narrower count; 23 is the honest number after the MTR-18 scanner fix, recorded not reconciled. 189 tests pass, clippy and fmt green.
